items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Ben Barlow, that's where she did the Strip E dance there.

ctx.x: I see. Played man guitar. And you signed? I made state of Tennessee cocaine habits Avalanche Bob Lee Junior. Oh, yeah. Avalanche man. Avalanche man. Let's get your name down here. We don't have it straight. Jenny May Clayton. Jenny May Clayton. I see. That's the name you recorded on that. Yes, sir. Well, I remembered seeing that somewhere. Where else did the band record, Shade? Chicago, Atlanta,
Georgia, St. Louis, Dallas, Texas. New York. I mean, Atlanta City, New Jersey. Atlantic City, New Jersey, huh? Sure. Ben Barlow, that's where she did the Strip E dance there.
